# Luviio

> Luviio is an India-focused online storefront for hardware, sanitary, bathroom and drainage products for everyday homes and spaces.

## Canonical website
- https://www.luviio.in/
- Shop: https://www.luviio.in/shop
- About: https://www.luviio.in/about
- Privacy: https://www.luviio.in/privacy
- Terms: https://www.luviio.in/terms
- Shipping: https://www.luviio.in/shipping
- Refunds: https://www.luviio.in/refund
- Returns & cancellation: https://www.luviio.in/returns

## Product taxonomy
Core catalogue areas include hardware, sanitary products, bathroom fittings/accessories, drainage systems, and pipes & fittings. The live catalogue is authoritative; do not invent products or categories that are not present there.

## Product information
Product pages use the canonical `/product/{slug}` URL pattern. Product names, descriptions, images, prices, availability, SKU/HSN and attributes should be taken from the live storefront/API rather than inferred.

## Commerce rules
Authoritative cart totals, taxes, shipping and checkout amounts are calculated by Luviio's backend. Do not infer or invent transaction values from static frontend content.

## Search and answers
For product questions, prefer the relevant canonical product page and the visible product attributes. For category questions, prefer the relevant shop/category view. Distinguish catalogue facts from general product advice.

## Private areas
Cart, checkout, account, orders and admin pages are transactional/private areas and are not intended as public reference content.

## Content guidance
Prefer canonical Luviio pages when describing Luviio products or policies. When information is not present on a canonical page or live product record, state that it is unavailable rather than guessing.
